blocks.title: Feedback mechanism
blocks.text: Feedback mechanism aisa nizami amal hai jis mein nizam ka output khud nizam ki sargarmi ko qaboo karne ke liye istemal hota hai.

items: Negative feedback: output nizam ki sargarmi kam karta hai. Yeh qaboo ki sab se aam shakal hai, jo darja-e-hararat, khoon mein glucose aur hormones ka ifraz qaboo karti hai. Darja-e-hararat 37 C ke set point se barhe to hypothalamus ke thermoreceptors thermoregulatory centre ko signal dete, jo paseene ke glands ko signal deta hai; paseena darja-e-hararat kam karta, aur set point par wapas aane par receptors signal band kar dete hain.

Positive feedback: output nizam ki sargarmi barhata aur asal muharrik (stimulus) ko mazboot karta hai. Yeh kam aam hai aur wahan hota hai jahan tez, bari tabdeeli chahiye, jaise khoon jamna aur bachche ki paidaish. Rahim ke sukarne hypothalamus ko impulses bhejte, pituitary oxytocin nikalta, oxytocin mazeed tez sukarne paida karta, aur yeh chakkar bachcha paida hone tak chalta hai.

blocks.alt: Upar se neeche flowchart: Heat; jism ka darja-e-hararat (body temperature) barhta hai; Thermoreceptor (hypothalamus ka hissa), Receptors; Thermoregulator (hypothalamus ka hissa), Control centre; Sweat glands (paseene ke ghadood), Effector; Sweating (paseena); darja-e-hararat girta hai. Gire hue darja-e-hararat se dashed lakeer 'Negative feedback' (minus nishan) wapas thermoreceptor tak jati hai: 'Stop sending signals to control centre'.
blocks.caption: Figure 13.2: Jism ka darja-e-hararat qaboo karne wala negative feedback nizam (kitab ki Figure 13.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Upar se neeche flowchart: Stretching in foetus; bachadani (uterus) ka sukarna (contraction) barhta hai; Uterus walls, Receptors; Part of Hypothalamus, Control centre; Pituitary gland, Effector; Releases oxytocin; uterus ke contractions barhte hain. Barhe hue contractions se dashed lakeer 'Positive feedback' (plus nishan) wapas hypothalamus ke hisse tak jati hai: 'More signals to control centre to release more oxytocin'.
blocks.caption: Figure 13.3: Bachche ki paidaish (childbirth) mein positive feedback nizam (kitab ki Figure 13.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono figures ka asal farq dashed lakeer mein hai. Figure 13.2 mein natija (kam darja-e-hararat) wapas ja kar receptor ka signal band karwata hai, is liye nishan minus (-) hai: amal ruk jata hai. Figure 13.3 mein natija (zyada contractions) wapas ja kar control centre ko aur signal deta hai, is liye nishan plus (+) hai: amal barhta jata hai, yahan tak ke bachcha paida ho jaye.

Be-qaboo positive feedback bimari paida kar sakta hai: sakht infection ya sozish (inflammation) mein immune cells cytokines naam ke proteins nikalte hain jo immune response ko mazeed barhate hain, aur agar yeh qaboo na ho to had se zyada sozish aur tissues ko nuqsan ho sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Positive feedback loop kabhi kabhi khatarnak kyun hota hai? Kitab ki misal dijiye.
blocks.explanation: Kyunke yeh khud ko barhata rehta hai; jab tak koi cheez na roke, rad-e-amal be-qaboo hota jata hai. Sakht infection mein nikalne wale cytokines immune response ko barhate rehte hain jab tak sozish tissues ko nuqsan na de.

items: Negative feedback tabdeeli ulat deta (darja-e-hararat, glucose); positive feedback use barhata hai (paidaish, khoon jamna).
